name: clike
description: From intent to impact. CLike keeps developers in flow, augments delivery with agentic workflows, and bakes in governance, eval‑driven quality, and a safe paved road for enterprises w/ an AI native pipeline.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: CLike runs local agents, git and file writes on the workspace.

enumDescriptions: Pro doc-style (colonna unica, neutro, allineato a VS Code)
Studio dark console (più denso, focus contenuti)
clike.chat.theme.description: Theme for the Chat CLike UI.

clike.harperTimeout.description: timeout in minutes for harper phase completions.

clike.eval.regression.description: /eval and /gate also re-run the acceptance checks of every promoted REQ (plan status done) against the new code (auto-eval L2: the REQ must not break what is already promoted).

clike.gate.strictWarnings.description: Block the gate when non-blocking checks fail (warnings). Off: warnings are reported and the gate passes (GATE_PASS_WITH_WARNINGS).

clike.autoEval.maxCycles.description: Maximum KIT repair cycles of /eval REQ --fix (auto-eval). Re-run the command to continue from the current state.

clike.autoEval.afterKit.description: After a successful /kit, run the auto-eval (/eval REQ --fix) automatically.

clike.kit.acceptanceFirst.description: Acceptance-first KIT: /kit REQ first generates only the acceptance tests and eval profile from SPEC/PLAN and locks them, then a second call writes the code against those locked tests (tests are not written by the same call as the code).

clike.chat.persistDir.description: Directory (relativa alla workspace) dove salvare le chat per modello (formato JSONL).

clike.chat.maxInMemoryMessages.description: Numero massimo di messaggi tenuti in memoria nella webview per non sforare RAM.

clike.chat.autoWriteGeneratedFiles.description: Se true, i file generati in mode=coding vengono scritti subito su FS.

clike.orchestratorUrl.description: Base URL for the Clike orchestrator API (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

clike.gatewayUrl.description: Base URL for the Clike gateway API (e.g. http://localhost:8000).

clike.optimizeFor.description: Optimization mode sent to the orchestrator.

clike.execution.defaultPreference.description: Default execution preference used by CLike for compatible tasks. Legacy values are normalized at runtime: auto -> cloud_only, hybrid -> prefer_local_agent, prefer_claude_code -> prefer_local_agent, claude_code_only -> local_agent_only.

clike.localAgent.enabled.description: Enable local agent execution for compatible Harper flows.

clike.localAgent.preferredExecutor.description: Preferred local agent executor when execution preference selects the local path.

clike.localAgent.allowEval.description: Enable local agent pre-pass for /eval before the canonical CLike eval path.

clike.localAgent.restrictToKitPhases.description: Restrict local agent usage to base /kit flows and disable local follow-up phases for now.

clike.localAgent.timeoutMinutes.description: Default timeout in minutes for local agent runs triggered by CLike.

clike.claudeCode.enabled.description: Enable Claude Code as a local executor when its CLI is installed. Set to false to disable Claude Code locally.

clike.claudeCode.restrictToKitPhases.description: Restrict Claude Code usage to compatible /kit flows.

clike.claudeCode.command.description: Executable used to invoke Claude Code locally.

clike.claudeCode.model.description: Model passed to Claude Code on every local run (--model). Use a tier alias like 'opus' or 'sonnet' to always get the latest model of that tier, or a full model id to pin a version. Leave empty to use the Claude CLI default.

clike.claudeCode.printModeFlag.description: Flag used for non-interactive Claude Code execution (for example -p or --print depending on your local version).

clike.claudeCode.timeoutMinutes.description: Timeout in minutes for synchronous Claude Code runs triggered by CLike.

clike.claudeCode.enableEval.description: Reserved for the next tranche. Keep false for now: /eval remains owned by CLike.

clike.claudeCode.permissionMode.description: Claude Code permission mode used for local non-interactive execution.

clike.localAgent.codex.enabled.description: Enable GPT Codex local executor integration when available locally.

clike.localAgent.codex.command.description: Executable used to invoke GPT Codex locally.

clike.localAgent.codex.model.description: Model passed to Codex on every local run (--model). Codex exposes no model-list command, so set the exact model id your Codex login supports; an invalid id makes the run fail. Leave empty to use the Codex CLI default.

clike.localAgent.codex.sandboxMode.description: Codex CLI sandbox mode. auto uses workspace-write for write-required local-agent phases and read-only for inspect-only phases.

clike.localAgent.codex.timeoutMinutes.description: Timeout in minutes for GPT Codex runs triggered by CLike.

clike.mcp.extensionServerEnabled.description: Expose the local CLike operational MCP-compatible server from the VS Code extension.

clike.mcp.extensionServerHost.description: Host for the local CLike extension operational MCP-compatible server.

clike.mcp.extensionServerPort.description: Port for the local CLike extension operational MCP-compatible server.

clike.mcp.extensionServerToken.description: Optional legacy override. Leave empty: a random token is generated and kept in VS Code SecretStorage (copy it with 'CLike: Copy Extension MCP Token'). The local MCP server always requires a token.

clike.apply.backup.description: If true, create a ~clike.bak backup before applying patches.

clike.apply.requireCleanGit.description: If true, require a clean Git working tree before applying patches.

clike.apply.dryRunPreview.description: If true, run a dry-run and show preview before applying the patch.

clike.git.autoCommit.description: Commit the files produced by each Harper phase (only those files) on the phase branch. Off by default.

clike.git.autoPush.description: Push phase commits, tags and gate merges to the configured remote. Off by default: commits stay local.

clike.git.gitMergeOnGate.description: After a PASS gate, merge the REQ branch into the default branch (--no-ff). Off by default.

clike.git.gitDeleteBranchOnMerge.description: If true, delete branch on merge.

clike.git.gitReturnToFeatureAfterMerge.description: If true, return to feature branch after merge.

clike.git.remoteUrl.description: Optional remote URL to set (e.g., git@github.com:org/repo.git). If empty, Clike will not add/set the remote automatically.

clike.git.commitMessage.description: Default commit message used for auto-commit.

clike.git.openPR.description: If true, open PR flow after auto-commit (requires GitHub extension).

clike.git.remote.description: Default remote name for PR flow.

clike.git.conventionalCommits.description: If true, use conventional commits for PR flow.

clike.git.pushRebase.description: If true, push changes after PR flow.

clike.git.prPerReqDraft.enabled.description: If true, create a PR per request draft.

clike.git.prPerReqDraft.useGhCli.description: If true, use GitHub CLI to create PRs.

clike.routes.description: Override default relative routes for orchestrator and gateway.
